statements.subject: server
statements.description: An EXPUNGE response MUST NOT be sent when no command is in progress, nor while responding to a FETCH, STORE, or SEARCH command.
statements.trigger: server attempts to send EXPUNGE response
statements.pre_cond: session.command_in_progress = false | session.active_command = FETCH | session.active_command = STORE | session.active_command = SEARCH

statements.subject: server
statements.description: An EXPUNGE response MAY be sent during a UID command.
statements.trigger: server elects to send EXPUNGE response
statements.pre_cond: session.active_command = UID_FETCH | session.active_command = UID_STORE | session.active_command = UID_SEARCH

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The update from the EXPUNGE response MUST be remembered by the client.
actions: decrement sequence numbers of all messages above expunged position
